description: This file contains unit tests for the MenuSessionsInjector component, focusing on menu item insertion, session injection, and cost usage display in a macOS application.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjectorTests
classes.description: A test suite for the MenuSessionsInjector, verifying its behavior in menu modifications and data injection.

methods.name: anchorsDynamicRowsBelowControlsAndActions
methods.description: Tests that the injector correctly finds the insert position for session rows below menu controls.

methods.name: injectsDisconnectedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that a disconnected control channel message is injected into the menu.

methods.name: injectsSessionRows
methods.description: Checks that session rows are injected correctly into the menu, with proper ordering.

methods.name: cost usage submenu does not use injector delegate
methods.description: Ensures that the cost usage submenu sets its delegate to nil and does not rely on the injector delegate.
